title: Killer Cases
description:
S03 E07 — Murder in Palm Beach County
Makeva Jenkins, a successful businesswoman and mother of three, boasts on Facebook that she has grown her business to six figures; hours later, she is shot dead with a bullet to the head.

title: Killer Cases
description:
S03 E09 — Murder on County Road M
Todd Kendhammer calls 911 in a panic, describing a freak accident involving his wife; police are suspicious of Todd's responses in the interrogation room; forensic details from the autopsy report cast further doubt on his story.

title: Killer Cases
description:
S03 E04 — Murder of the Basketball Star
Ten days after NBA player Lorenzen Wright goes missing, the player's body is found in a swamp, shot 11 times; police search for clues to identify who killed the basketball star.

title: Killer Cases
description:
S02 E03 — Murder and the Missing Mom
Despite a massive search, a missing woman was never found; a private detective suggests that the missing woman's husband is responsible, and he is arrested.

title: Killer Cases
description:
S02 E06 — Murder in a College Town
Popular college senior Samantha Josephson goes missing after a night of socializing at a bar area popular with students; tragically, her body is found 24 hours later with more than 100 stab wounds.

title: Killer Cases
description:
S01 E05 — Murder In A Wisconsin Field
Nicole VanderHeyden is found shot to death in a Wisconsin farm field; police immediately arrest her live-in boyfriend, who waited 18 hours to report her missing and has a history of domestic violence.

title: Killer Cases
description:
S02 E09 — Murder on Middle Mountain
A 13-year-old doesn't show up for a play date and is reported missing, setting off a manhunt in the rough Colorado wilderness; when his badly decomposed remains are found by hikers three years later, prosecutors charge the teen's father with murder.

title: Murder at the Motel
description:
S01 E02 — The Bad Guy Did It
Officers from the Reno Police Department are dispatched to the La Quinta Inn, where they discover the remains of a 42-year-old woman who was shot 23 times, and a key piece of evidence is from one of the victim's sons.

title: Murder at the Motel
description:
S01 E04 — Murder in the Parish
The Sheriff's Office in DeRidder, LA, receives a distressing phone call from the owner of Dee's Motel; the man tells them that he's found a woman dead in room six.

title: Murder at the Motel
description:
S01 E05 — A Krazy Killing
Deputies from the Riverside County Sheriff's Department respond to the scene of an abandoned vehicle in a remote area of the Gavilan Hills; investigators discovered corpses of two men stuffed in the trunk.

title: Murder at the Motel
description:
S01 E06 — A Chance Encounter
January 5, 2016, Baltimore, MD: Police officers respond to a report of a deceased man found at the Deluxe Plaza Motel in Northeast Baltimore; the victim, US Navy Veteran Edward Yesaitis, was discovered by the motel's cleaning crew.

title: Murder in the 21st
description:
S01 E01 — A Deadly Post
Police are hard-pressed to find solid leads when a 19-year-old girl vanishes without a trace; after her body is found dead on an isolated road, a frenzy of theories and suspicion takes detectives down a web of confusion until the truth is revealed.

title: Murder in the 21st
description:
S01 E04 — The Brutal Truth
A brutal attack on two employees of a high-end shop leaves one woman dead and another scarred by the memory of the events she survived; as detectives make sense of the tale, bizarre clues bring them to the truth.

title: Murder in the 21st
description:
S01 E08 — Tainted Love
A sudden illness takes hold of a beloved doctor, leaving her family helpless as the illness takes a fatal turn; the investigation into her death takes her family on a journey into the dark heart of a monster who has been at their side all along.

title: The Menendez Murders: Erik Tells All
description:
S01 E01 — A Murder in Beverly Hills
In 1989, 21-year-old Lyle and 18-year-old Erik Menendez walked into their parents' den and killed them; Erik shared details of the events of the week leading up to the murders and the motive behind the crime.

title: The Menendez Murders: Erik Tells All
description:
S01 E02 — A Family With a Dirty Secret
The trial takes a shocking turn when the defense claims Erik and Lyle Menendez killed their parents after years of sexual abuse; Erik gives his account of growing up in a "house of horrors."

title: The Menendez Murders: Erik Tells All
description:
S01 E03 — Abuse Excuse?
Erik recalls his mother's decline in the years leading up to the murders and looks on in agony as his brother Lyle testifies, vividly describing the abuse at the hands of their father.

title: The Menendez Murders: Erik Tells All
description:
S01 E04 — Trials and Reversals
The first trial ends in a surprise verdict; Erik discusses the preparation for his second trial, his unlikely connection with O.J. Simpson, and why he alone speaks for both the brothers as a second jury weighs a sentence of life in prison or death.

title: The Menendez Murders: Erik Tells All
description:
S01 E05 — Final Verdict
The verdict arrives; Erik and his brother, Lyle, are sent to separate prisons; Erik marries and begins to mount an appeal.

title: Beyond the Headlines: The Gabby Petito Story
description: Chronicling the twists and turns of the tragic road trip through the lens of Gabby's social media presence as told by the people who knew her best.

title: Beyond the Headlines: The Jennifer Dulos Story
description: A look at the marriage of Jennifer Dulos and Fotis Dulos through the point of view of those closest to them, as well as the police investigation, murder charges and Fotis Dulos' suicide.

title: Cold Case Files: DNA Speaks
description:
S01 E01 — A Fatal Path
When 14-year-old Nacole Smith is brutally murdered in 1995 on a wooded path in Atlanta, the police and community rally around her mother as she seeks justice; it will take decades and a second brutal assault to finally reveal Nacole's killer.
